info.name: Job Scheduler API - Complete
info.description:
Complete API collection for the Job Scheduler application with all CRUD operations for Users, Organizations, Job Templates, Jobs, Job Notifications, Job Executions, Informatica Job Runs, and AI Chat Assistant. Includes JWT authentication, organization management, comprehensive job monitoring, Informatica integration, and intelligent AI-powered data queries and insights.

## 🔄 Update Operations & Filtering

All update endpoints support **partial updates** - you only need to include the fields you want to change. Here's a quick reference:

### **Users** (`PUT /api/v1/users/{user_id}`)
- `username`, `email`, `password`, `is_active`
- Example: `{"username": "new_name"}` or `{"is_active": false}`

### **Organizations** (`PUT /api/v1/organizations/{organization_id}`)
- `name`, `description`, `domain`, `is_active`, `configuration`, `identifier`, `username`, `password`, `environment`
- Example: `{"name": "New Name", "is_active": false}`

### **Job Templates** (`PUT /api/v1/job-templates/{job_template_id}`)
- `title`, `description`, `script_type`, `script_content`, `script_path`, `parameters_schema`, `is_active`, `organization_id`
- Example: `{"title": "New Title", "is_active": true}`

### **Jobs** (`PUT /api/v1/jobs/{job_id}`)
- Job fields: `title`, `parameters`, `status`, `trigger_type`, `frequency_*`, `cron_expression`, `timeout_seconds`, `max_retries`, `trigger_on`
- Email notifications: `emailIds` array
- Example: `{"job": {"status": "running"}, "emailIds": ["admin@example.com"]}`

### **Job Notifications** (`PUT /api/v1/job-notifications/{notification_id}`)
- `job_id`, `notification_type`, `trigger_on`, `configuration`, `is_active`
- Example: `{"trigger_on": "failure", "is_active": false}`

### **User-Organization Mappings** (`PUT /api/v1/user-organizations/{mapping_id}`)
- `role`, `is_active`
- Example: `{"role": "admin"}` or `{"is_active": false}`

### **Special Operations**
- **Toggle Notification Status** (`PATCH /api/v1/job-notifications/{notification_id}/toggle`): Automatically switches between enabled/disabled states

## 🎯 Best Practices
1. **Partial Updates**: Only send the fields you want to change
2. **Validation**: All fields are validated before processing
3. **Atomic Operations**: Updates are processed atomically
4. **Audit Trail**: All changes are logged with timestamps

request.description:
Update an existing job and its notification emails. The job update and email notifications are handled together.

**Job fields to update (all optional):**
- `title`: Job title
- `parameters`: Job parameters object
- `status`: Job status (pending/running/completed/failed)
- `trigger_type`: Trigger type (manual/frequency/cron)
- `frequency_interval`: Frequency interval number
- `frequency_unit`: Frequency unit (minutes/hours/days)
- `frequency_count`: Frequency count
- `frequency_end_time`: End time for frequency
- `cron_expression`: Cron expression for scheduling
- `timeout_seconds`: Job timeout in seconds
- `max_retries`: Maximum retry attempts
- `trigger_on`: Trigger condition (success/failure/both)

**Email notifications:**
- `emailIds`: Array of email addresses for notifications

**Example filters:**
- Update only title: `{"job": {"title": "New Job Name"}, "emailIds": []}`
- Update status and timeout: `{"job": {"status": "running", "timeout_seconds": 7200}, "emailIds": ["admin@example.com"]}`
- Update scheduling: `{"job": {"cron_expression": "0 2 * * *"}, "emailIds": ["user@example.com"]}`

request.description:
Update an existing job notification. All fields are optional - only include the fields you want to update.

**Available fields to update:**
- `job_id`: Job ID
- `notification_type`: Notification type (email/slack/webhook)
- `trigger_on`: Trigger condition (success/failure/both)
- `configuration`: Configuration object (e.g., emails array, webhook URL)
- `is_active`: Boolean to enable/disable notification

**Example filters:**
- Update only trigger condition: `{"trigger_on": "failure"}`
- Update email list: `{"configuration": {"emails": ["new@email.com"]}}`
- Update multiple fields: `{"trigger_on": "both", "is_active": false}`
- Enable/disable: `{"is_active": false}`
Delete a job notification

Toggle the active status of a job notification. This endpoint switches the notification between enabled and disabled states.

**What it does:**
- If notification is currently active (`is_active: true`), it will be deactivated
- If notification is currently inactive (`is_active: false`), it will be activated

**Use cases:**
- Temporarily disable notifications without deleting them
- Re-enable previously disabled notifications
- Quick on/off toggle for notification management

**No body required** - the endpoint automatically toggles the current state

item.name: AI Chat Assistant

request.description:
Send a message to the AI chat assistant. The AI can answer questions about:
- Inactive users (e.g., 'users inactive for 30 days')
- Long running jobs (e.g., 'jobs running for over 10 minutes')
- Recent job executions (e.g., 'last 10 jobs', 'list 10 jobs')
- Job statistics (e.g., 'job success rate')
- Recently logged users (e.g., 'last 10 logged users')
- Job type specific queries (e.g., 'get last 10 jobs of type MTT_TEST')
- Failed jobs by type (e.g., 'failed MTT_TEST jobs')
- Successful jobs by type (e.g., 'successful MTT_TEST jobs')
- Long running jobs by type (e.g., 'MTT_TEST jobs over 15 minutes')
